row.evidence: Mural's pricing page lists 'SCIM user and group management' only under Enterprise (Contact for pricing), and its SCIM docs say SCIM is available only with Mural's Enterprise plan.
row.notes: Unchanged from June: SCIM is Enterprise-only (Contact Sales); Team+ $9.99 and Business $17.99 per member/mo billed annually (Team+ $12 monthly). SAML SSO starts on Business, one tier below SCIM, and must be working before SCIM is configured. SCIM auth uses an Authorization: apikey <key> header from the company dashboard. DELETE is a hard delete; PATCH active=false is the reversible deactivation Okta uses (Okta cannot delete). Enterprise API (member information, user-type/licence updates, users report, audit log) is listed with Enterprise's reporting APIs.

plans.name: Team+
plans.price_text: $9.99 per member/month billed annually ($12 billed monthly)

auth.token_source: Company dashboard > Identity and access > Provisioning > Create SCIM API key (managed on the API keys page)

deprovision.data_retained: Deactivation is a reversible soft delete; DELETE hard-deletes the user's identity data (Mural recommends transferring content ownership first).

filtering.notes: Only filtering by email is available; no sort.

attributes.notes: Attribute table on About the SCIM API maps email, givenName, familyName, userName, userType, active (locked), profileUrl (avatar), id.

roles.how: SCIM groups map to workspaces with designated permissions; on tiered Member pricing, groups set Full vs Limited Member user type.

rate_limits.text: More than 25 requests per second returns 429.

limitations.text: Only members, not guests, can be provisioned.
No filter or sort on GET except lookup by email.
Okta cannot delete Mural users (deactivate only).
Invalid custom profile fields cause all fields to be ignored.
Group-to-workspace mapping should stay under 40,000 users per workspace.

capabilities.notes: Non-SCIM Enterprise API reads members and bulk-updates user types; lifecycle changes go through SCIM.

endpoints.purpose: List company members (username, name, email, license, status)
Audit log events (up to 30 days per call)

rate_limits.text: Audit log API: 1,500 calls per day per customer.

user_api.notes: Plan for the Enterprise API is taken from the pricing page, which lists audit logs, downloadable reports and reporting APIs under Enterprise; the API docs do not name a plan for the member information endpoints.

okta.notes: OIN page marks SAML, SCIM and Create/Update/Deactivate/Group Push as checked (read from page markup).
